translations.u004: In addition to the other definitions contained in these General Terms and Conditions, the terms set out below, when written with an initial capital letter, shall have the meanings attributed to them herein. The definitions identify the meaning of the terms and neither replace nor duplicate the provisions contained in the articles governing the individual matters, to which reference is made.
translations.u005: “1 Euro Auction”: a specific category of Auction organised and classified as such by Fleequid, which may be used, depending on the applicable Sales Model, both in the context of the Commission Sale and in Dealer Sales, characterised by specific methods for determining the price and by specific financial terms, governed by the relevant Special Sale Terms and Conditions and regulated by Art. 9.4, letter d).
translations.u006: “Binding Agreement”: the agreement by which, in the manner provided for in Art. 10.2, the Sales Contract relating to the Vehicle is concluded and the Buyer's obligation to pay the Total Amount Due arises. The conclusion of the Binding Agreement does not depend on payment and does not constitute a Final Award.
translations.u007: “Buyer(s)”: the Bidder in whose favour the Binding Agreement has been concluded and who is therefore obliged to pay the Total Amount Due, regardless of the type of Sales Event and of whether payment has been made. In the Commission Sale, whether performed by means of Resale or with Fleequid acting as a Pure Intermediary, the term always refers to the substantial Buyer, a different entity from Fleequid; in Dealer Sales the Buyer is the person who purchases the Vehicle from Fleequid. In transactions supported by a Financing Solution the Buyer may be the Financier, in the cases and on the terms provided for in Art. 22.5.
translations.u008: “Final Award”: the event, exclusive to Auctions, which occurs upon full performance of the payment obligation pursuant to Art. 12.2 and which, together with the commencement of the performance phase of the transaction, constitutes the effect thereof. The Final Award does not constitute the moment of conclusion of the Contract, which is concluded by the Binding Agreement, and its failure to occur does not affect the existence of the Contract already concluded. In Sales Events other than Auctions, the commencement of the performance phase follows full performance of the payment obligation without giving rise to a Final Award.
translations.u009: “Cancellation of the Sale”: the contractual mechanism, governed in general terms by Art. 14, by which Fleequid determines, in the cases provided for, that the transaction shall not be performed or shall cease to be performed, in whole or in respect of one or more Vehicles only. The actual legal basis of the Cancellation depends on the circumstances giving rise to it; where it follows a breach covered by an express termination clause, it operates as termination pursuant to Art. 1456 of the Italian Civil Code.
translations.u010: “Auction”: a Sales Event consisting of an online sales process carried out via the Marketplace, which includes one or more Bids and ends, in the cases and under the conditions provided for in these General Terms and Conditions, with the conclusion of the Binding Agreement in favour of the highest Bidder.
translations.u011: “Starting Price”: the initial or minimum price of the Vehicle from which, where provided for by the applicable Sales Event method, Bidders can place Bids or raised bids.
translations.u012: “User Classification”: the internal, operational and dynamic status assigned by Fleequid to the User on the basis of objective factors relating to the User's history and conduct, with the effects and within the limits provided for in Art. 6.
translations.u013: “Commissions”: the consideration owed to Fleequid by the Seller and the Buyer for the purchase and sale of Vehicles carried out using the Marketplace or Fleequid's trading services and systems, solely in the Sales Models that provide for them. Unless otherwise agreed in writing, or otherwise indicated in the Special Sale Terms and Conditions, the Commissions are determined based on the Fleequid Fee Schedule. In the Commission Sale, for the purposes of calculating the Reserve Price, only the Commissions contractually charged to the Seller are relevant. The accrual of the Commissions is governed by Art. 12.4. In Dealer Sales no Commissions are due and the financial result of Fleequid's purchase and sale activity does not constitute a Commission.
translations.u014: “Buy Now”: the Sales Event method, stand-alone or associated with a Bidding Auction, governed by Art. 9.4, letter b), in which the Bid is placed at the immediate purchase price indicated for the Vehicle.
translations.u015: “General Terms and Conditions” or “GTC”: these general terms and conditions of contract, available in the relevant section of the Marketplace, which regulate the relationship between Fleequid and all Users and constitute the general contractual framework in accordance with the hierarchy set out in Art. 4.3.
translations.u016: “Special Sale Terms and Conditions”: the contractual conditions that establish the parameters, conditions and express derogations relating to the individual transaction or the individual Sales Event, applicable in accordance with Arts. 4.3, 4.4 and 4.5.
translations.u017: “Specific Terms and Conditions”: the contractual conditions, additional to these GTC, which contain the special, standardised and recurring rules applicable to an identifiable category of transactions, Services, products or matters, applicable in accordance with Arts. 4.3 and 4.4.
translations.u018: “Consumer”: the natural person who acts for purposes other than any entrepreneurial, commercial, craft or professional activity carried out, pursuant to Art. 3 of Legislative Decree No 206 of 6 September 2005.
translations.u019: “Contract”: depending on the case, each of the contractual relationships relevant under these General Terms and Conditions and also governed by any Specific Terms and Conditions, Special Sale Terms and Conditions and Individual Contracts, and in particular: (i) in the Commission Sale performed by means of Resale, the sale of the Vehicle by the Seller to Fleequid and the subsequent Resale to the Buyer; (ii) in the Commission Sale performed by Fleequid as a Pure Intermediary, the direct sale of the Vehicle by the Seller to the Buyer; (iii) in Dealer Sales, the sale of the Vehicle by the Seller to Fleequid and the subsequent sale of the same Vehicle by Fleequid to the Buyer, as separate and independent contracts; as well as the marketing relationship entered into between the Seller and Fleequid pursuant to Arts. 8.7 and 8.8. The conclusion of the Binding Agreement relating to the sale to the Buyer is governed by Art. 10.2; the relationships of purchase, sale and transfer of the Vehicle are governed, depending on the applicable Sales Model and the chosen method of performance, by Arts. 8.8, 16, 17 and 18 and by the further applicable provisions. As regards the form of the Sales Contracts, the provisions of the last sentence of Art. 10.2 remain unaffected.
translations.u020: “Individual Contract”: the agreement formalised in writing and approved by Fleequid with one or more specific Users, ranking first in the hierarchy of contractual sources pursuant to Art. 4.3.
translations.u021: “Dealer Sales”: the Sales Model, governed by Arts. 2.7 and 18, in which Fleequid purchases the Vehicle from the Seller in its own name and on its own behalf and resells it in its own name and on its own behalf to the Buyer, being a substantial party to both sales, which are separate and independent.
translations.u022: “Security Deposit”: the sum of money that the Bidder is required to pay to Fleequid, in the cases and in the amount provided for in Art. 6, as security for the performance of the obligations undertaken and for Fleequid's claims relating to the specific transaction. The Security Deposit does not constitute a penalty and is not an independent basis for any charge.
translations.u023: “Sales Event”: any commercial process organised or managed by Fleequid and aimed at the sale of one or more Vehicles, in accordance with the methods provided for in Art. 9.4, namely the Auction, Buy Now, whether as a stand-alone method or associated with a Bidding Auction, the Private Sale, the Negotiation and the Off-Auction Sale.
translations.u024: “Financier”: the third party that grants or disburses financing to the User in the context of a Financing Solution and that, depending on the product chosen and the applicable Specific Terms and Conditions, may act as payer, as recipient of the invoice or as Buyer pursuant to Art. 22.5.
translations.u025: “Fleequid”: mainly refers to the company Adorea S.r.l., with registered office in Via Provinciale per Bizzarone, 43 – 22077 Olgiate Comasco (CO), Tax Code and VAT number 04114790134, registration in the Como Business Register No 420825, e-mail info@fleequid.com, owner of the Fleequid® trademark. The term may also refer to other legal entities, affiliated with or designated by Adorea S.r.l. for the marketing of Vehicles, in accordance with Art. 2.9. Fleequid operates the Marketplace and makes the Services available; the capacity in which it acts in the individual transaction depends on the applicable Sales Model and, in the Commission Sale, on the chosen method of performance, in accordance with Arts. 2.3-2.8, 3, 17 and 18. Fleequid's position with regard to Vehicles qualifying as ELVs or otherwise as waste is governed by Arts. 16.13 and 18.8.
translations.u026: “Encumbrance”: any lien or encumbrance, guarantee right, pledge, enforcement order, contractual obligation, retention of title, obligation relating to taxes or duties, mortgage or other encumbrance, of any nature whatsoever, weighing on the Vehicle and capable of preventing or making more difficult its legal circulation and marketability. Any characteristic of the Vehicle which does not allow for its free circulation within the European Union, or the absence of CE certification in accordance with applicable European Union legislation, if required, is to be considered an Encumbrance.
translations.u027: “Total Amount Due”: the total amount owed by the Buyer in relation to the specific transaction, including, depending on the applicable Sales Model and the chosen method of performance, the Sale Price to the Buyer, the Commissions, the Fees, any reimbursement of expenses and VAT where due. The Total Amount Due is indicated in the Proforma, save for manifest clerical error; where Fleequid acts as a Pure Intermediary, the Proforma sets out separately the components due to the Seller and those due to Fleequid.
translations.u028: “Listing” (or “Auction data sheet”): the informative and descriptive content relating to the Vehicle and to the specific transaction, including, by way of example but not limited to, the Technical Specifications, the images, the technical dossier, any TrustReport and any other information made available to Users, which also serves to contain, identify or refer to the Special Sale Terms and Conditions and to make known the elements provided for in Art. 3.2, as governed by Art. 4.6.
translations.u029: “Pure Intermediary”: the method of performance of the Commission Sale, governed by Arts. 2.6 and 17.10 et seq., in which Fleequid does not carry out the Resale, neither purchases nor sells the Vehicle and does not conclude the sale, either in its own name or as a party, allowing the transfer and invoicing of the Vehicle to take place directly from the Seller to the Buyer. The Pure Intermediary does not constitute a separate Sales Model and remains an internal method of performance of the Commission Sale.
translations.u030: “Marketplace”: the auction platforms and other platforms, the apps, the websites and the integrated services which constitute an online marketplace in which Users can, in the cases and under the conditions established by these GTC and by the further applicable sources, purchase and sell Vehicles as well as request and use the other Services made available by Fleequid, including, in particular, the Fleequid website at the following address: https://www.fleequid.com.
translations.u031: “Sales Model”: the legal structure according to which Fleequid organises the individual sales transaction, identified pursuant to Art. 3 from among the only two Models provided for in Art. 2.3, namely the Commission Sale and Dealer Sales.
translations.u032: “Negotiation”: the Sales Event method, governed by Art. 9.4, letter e), consisting of a negotiation in the course of which Bids and counter-offers may be made and in which the Binding Agreement is concluded upon acceptance of the Bid or of the counter-offer.
translations.u033: “Bidder”: Professional User who participates in a Sales Event, making one or more Bids. The Bidder acquires the status of Buyer at the moment the Binding Agreement is concluded in their favour.
translations.u034: “Bid”: the declaration of intent by which the Bidder offers to purchase the Vehicle at a specific price in the context of a Sales Event. The Bid is binding and irrevocable as provided for in Arts. 10.1 and 10.5 and presupposes that the applicable Sales Model has been identified and made known in advance pursuant to Art. 3.
translations.u035: “Advance Payment”: the advance payment, equal to 30% of the Total Amount Due, which may be requested from the Buyer in transactions in which the Vehicle temporarily remains in use by the Seller, in accordance with Art. 13. The Advance Payment is made on account of the price and constitutes neither a confirmatory deposit nor a withdrawal deposit.
translations.u036: “Parties”: means jointly Fleequid, the Seller, the Bidder and the Buyer. The Financier is not a Party to these General Terms and Conditions, unless it acquires the status of Buyer pursuant to Art. 22.5.
translations.u037: “MCSP” or “Minimum Commitment to Sell Price”: the price, expressed in EUR, established by the Seller at the time of the Offer to Sell, which represents the minimum net proceeds that the Seller intends to obtain from the sale of the Vehicle. The MCSP is binding and may be changed only before the start of the relevant Sales Event; in the event of revision in view of a subsequent sales attempt, the provisions of Art. 8.10 shall apply.
translations.u038: “Purchase Price”: the price of the Vehicle due to the Seller in Dealer Sales, independently agreed between Fleequid and the Seller pursuant to Art. 18.3.
translations.u039: “Net Purchase Price”: the price of the Vehicle due from Fleequid to the Seller in the Commission Sale performed by means of Resale, corresponding to the Sale Price to the Buyer net of the Commissions payable by the Seller, the Fees and any other sum owed by the Seller to Fleequid, determined and payable in accordance with Art. 17.4.
translations.u040: “Reserve Price” or “RP”: the gross value, determined by Fleequid on the basis of the MCSP set by the Seller and the Commissions payable by the Seller as per the Fleequid Fee Schedule, which represents, in the Commission Sale, the price threshold at which, or above which, the Seller irrevocably agrees to the sale of the Vehicle, ensuring the Seller net proceeds at least equal to the MCSP. In Dealer Sales any Reserve Price relates exclusively to the resale of the Vehicle by Fleequid to the Buyer and is determined independently by Fleequid pursuant to Art. 9.5.
translations.u041: “Sale Price to the Buyer”: the price of the Vehicle resulting from the Binding Agreement, however formed according to the applicable Sales Event method, owed by the Buyer and forming part of the Total Amount Due.
translations.u042: “Professional”: the natural or legal person acting in the exercise of their entrepreneurial, commercial, craft or professional activity, or their intermediary, with the exclusion of Consumers. This definition also includes ‘microenterprises,’ i.e., entities, companies, or associations that, regardless of their legal form, carry out an economic activity, even on an individual or family basis, employing fewer than ten people and having an annual turnover or annual balance sheet total not exceeding EUR 2 million, pursuant to Art. 2(3) of the Annex to Commission Recommendation No 2003/361/EC of 6 May 2003, and Art. 18(1)(d-bis) of Legislative Decree No 206/2005 (Consumer Code).
translations.u043: “Proforma”: the document by which Fleequid notifies the Buyer of the Total Amount Due and of the expiry of the Payment Period and, in the Commission Sale, crystallises the chosen method of performance, in accordance with Art. 11.4. The Proforma is an implementing and declaratory document subsequent to the Binding Agreement, is not a contractual source, does not constitute a tax document and does not give rise to new obligations.
translations.u044: “Offer to Sell”: the declaration of intent by which the Seller grants Fleequid the mandate to proceed with the marketing and sale of one or more Vehicles via the Marketplace or through the other available methods. The form, minimum content, effectiveness and binding nature of the Offer to Sell are governed by Art. 8.1.
translations.u045: “Highest Bid”: the highest value among all the Bids submitted by the Bidders at the end of the Auction, even after any increments. Where Fleequid has proceeded with the Cancellation of the Sale, the Highest Bid is determined by excluding the value of the Bids relating to the cancelled sales.
translations.u046: “Resale”: the method of performance of the Commission Sale, governed by Arts. 2.5 and 17.3 et seq. and also capable of being implemented in the forms referred to in Art. 1395 of the Italian Civil Code, by which Fleequid, in performance of the commission mandates to sell and to purchase, purchases the Vehicle from the Seller and transfers it to the Buyer in order to attribute the sale to the respective principals. The Resale does not apply in Dealer Sales.
translations.u047: “Services”: the services, offline and online, made available by Fleequid to Users and subject to Fees, such as, by way of example, transport and logistics services for Vehicles and the other services indicated on the Marketplace, with the exclusion of the activity of intermediation in the purchase and sale of Vehicles, which is subject to Commissions.
translations.u048: “Financing Solutions”: the financing, finance lease or other funding products offered by third parties and made available or indicated via the Marketplace, governed by Art. 22 and by the relevant Specific Terms and Conditions.
translations.u049: “Technical Specifications”: the set of information, provided by the Seller or indicated by Fleequid and approved by the Seller, concerning the characteristics, technical and administrative, of each of the Vehicles offered for sale.
translations.u050: “Optioned Status”: the status of the Vehicle, subsequent to the conclusion of the Binding Agreement and prior to full performance of the payment obligation and the commencement of the performance phase or to the Cancellation of the Sale, with the effects provided for in Art. 11. The Optioned Status describes a phase of the sales process, does not grant the Buyer any right to choose subsequently whether to purchase, does not constitute an irrevocable offer and does not amount to an option contract pursuant to Art. 1331 of the Italian Civil Code.
translations.u051: “Fleequid Fee Schedule”: the set of conditions that regulate the calculation, also in terms of a percentage of the Sale Price to the Buyer, of the Commissions due to Fleequid from the Seller and from the Buyer, as well as of the further amounts indicated therein, which can be consulted at the following links: https://fleequid.com/it/pricing-seller and https://fleequid.com/it/pricing-buyer.
translations.u052: “Fees”: the consideration, other than Commissions, due to Fleequid for the provision of one or more Services.
translations.u053: “Payment Period”: the period within which the Buyer must pay the Total Amount Due in full, determined pursuant to Art. 11.5 and, in the cases provided for in those provisions, pursuant to Arts. 11.6, 11.7, 13 and 22.7.
translations.u054: “TrustReport”: the Vehicle inspection document prepared by Fleequid or commissioned by it from third parties, which is of an exclusively informative nature within the scope and with the effects provided for in Art. 19.5. The TrustReport constitutes neither a warranty nor a certification of the condition of the Vehicle, does not replace the Buyer's inspection and does not release the Seller from its liabilities and obligations.
translations.u055: “User”: any Professional, sole proprietorship or legal entity who has completed the Marketplace registration process, or has otherwise joined it by approving these General Terms and Conditions, in order to access, view and use the Marketplace, participate in the Sales Events to offer to buy or sell Vehicles and benefit from the Services offered, including Sellers, Bidders and Buyers.
translations.u056: “Vehicle”: any motor vehicle, new or used, sold or listed on the Marketplace or otherwise marketed through Fleequid, including but not limited to buses, trucks, vans, cars and other means of transportation.
translations.u057: “End-of-Life Vehicle(s)” or “ELV”: any Vehicle which, under the environmental legislation applicable in the country where the asset is located at the time of transfer, qualifies as waste or is intended for scrapping and the recovery of materials. The relevant rules are contained in Arts. 8.3, 16.13, 18.8 and 20.8.
translations.u058: “Off-Auction Sale”: the Sales Event method, governed by Art. 9.4, letter f), in which the sale is concluded outside the Auction process.
translations.u059: “Commission Sale”: the Sales Model, governed by Arts. 2.3, 2.4, 2.5, 2.6 and 17, in which Fleequid, under an irrevocable mandate from the Users, arranges on their behalf the sale and purchase of the Vehicle and in which the transaction is performed, alternatively, by means of Resale or with Fleequid acting as a Pure Intermediary. Fleequid's classification as a commission agent acting in its own name pursuant to Art. 1731 of the Italian Civil Code applies exclusively in the Resale, in accordance with Art. 2.5; where Fleequid acts as a Pure Intermediary, the sale is concluded directly between the Seller and the Buyer pursuant to Arts. 2.6 and 17.10.
translations.u060: “Private Sale”: the Sales Event method, governed by Art. 9.4, letter c), intended for one or more Users identified by Fleequid and not visible to Marketplace Users generally.
translations.u061: “Seller”: any Professional who uses Fleequid's sales services and who offers to sell their Vehicles. The term always refers to the substantial Seller, a different entity from Fleequid; in the Commission Sale performed by means of Resale, where Fleequid takes on the role of formal seller, it is always referred to as Fleequid. In Dealer Sales the Seller is the person from whom Fleequid purchases the Vehicle; in the subsequent resale to the Buyer the seller is Fleequid pursuant to Arts. 2.7 and 18.1.
translations.u062: Any reference in these GTC to ‘days’ is to be understood as referring to working days, where ‘working days’ are understood to mean the days of the week from Monday to Friday, from 8.30 am to 12.30 pm and from 2 pm to 6 pm, excluding any public holidays in Italy. The applicable time zone is that of Fleequid's registered office. This method of calculation applies to all time limits provided for in these General Terms and Conditions, including the Payment Period, the maximum time limit referred to in Art. 12.7 and the penalties determined for each day of delay.

La v8 EN usa già 'award/awarded/awarding' per aggiudicare. Da far validare allo studio.

notes: u062: mantenuta alla lettera la resa v8 degli orari ('8.30 am to 12.30 pm and from 2 pm to 6 pm'): il controllo numeri la segnala come falso positivo rispetto a 8:30/12:30/14:00/18:00 dell'IT.

GTC: nelle Generali EN v8 l'abbreviazione definita è 'GTC' (mai 'GTCs'); il glossario cumulativo riporta 'GTCs' dalle T&C Fleequid Care. Mantenuto 'GTC', che è il termine definito di questo documento.
Aggiudicazione definitiva = 'Final Award' (scelta del revisore, al posto di 'Final Successful Bid'): da validare con lo studio; va usata ovunque nel documento.

Termini v8 conservati: 'Auction' (tolto 'or Sale(s)' dal termine definito perché ora la categoria generale è 'Sales Event'), 'Bid' per Offerta anche fuori dalle Aste, 'Offer to Sell', 'substantial Buyer/Seller', 'Starting Price', 'Pure Intermediary', 'Fleequid Fee Schedule', 'Fees', 'Reserve Price' (v8 def. 'Reserve price', nel corpo 'Reserve Price').

Virgolette: i termini definiti sono tra “ ” come nell'IT v9 (la v8 EN non le aveva, salvo “1 Euro Auction”); nei paragrafi ripresi dalla v8 restano le virgolette semplici originali (‘microenterprises,’ ‘days’).
u025: 'Adorea S.r.l.' uniformato (la v8 EN aveva 'Adorea Srl' alla prima occorrenza); e-mail senza sottolineato perché l'IT v9 non lo ha.
u051: URL lasciati con /it/ come nell'IT (li localizza il sistema).
u035: 'caparra confirmatoria né penitenziale' reso 'neither a confirmatory deposit nor a withdrawal deposit', senza glossa italiana tra parentesi.

u061: nell'IT v9 manca la punteggiatura tra 'soggetto diverso rispetto a Fleequid' e 'nella Vendita in commissione eseguita mediante Rivendita, ove Fleequid assuma...': tradotto con punto e virgola secondo il senso della v8.
u046 e altrove: 'commissioni di vendita e di acquisto' (minuscolo, incarichi) reso 'commission mandates to sell and to purchase' per non confonderlo con 'Commissions' (corrispettivi).
review: u006, u008, u184: Final Successful Bid → Final Award — termine definito nuovo: nella v9 l'evento nasce dal pagamento e non dall'offerta; 'Bid' è termine definito e la resa precedente era confondibile con Bid/Highest Bid e con il 'final Successful Bid' della v8 (che era il momento vincolante, ora Binding Agreement); la v8 usa già 'awarded/awarding'.
u005: specific economic conditions → specific financial terms — 'economic conditions' in inglese indica la congiuntura; 'condizioni economiche' di un'operazione sono 'financial terms'.
u005, u019, u027: according to / depending on the applicable Sales Model → sempre 'depending on the applicable Sales Model' — resa unica di 'secondo il Modello di Vendita applicabile'.
u007: within the terms provided for in Art. 22.5 → on the terms provided for — 'within the terms' si legge come termine temporale; l'IT 'nei termini' qui significa 'alle condizioni'.
u034: binding and irrevocable within the terms provided for in → as provided for in — stessa ragione: evita la lettura 'entro i termini'.
u008: specific exclusively to Auctions → exclusive to Auctions — pleonasmo/calco.

u008: the moment at which the Contract is concluded, which is concluded with the Binding Agreement → the moment of conclusion of the Contract, which is concluded by the Binding Agreement — antecedente ambiguo del relativo.
u009: in whole or limited to one or more Vehicles → in whole or in respect of one or more Vehicles only — costruzione non parallela.
u011: by the method of the applicable Sales Event → by the applicable Sales Event method — coerenza con 'Sales Event method' (u014, u032, u041, u058, u060).
u013: on the basis of the Fleequid Fee Schedule → based on the Fleequid Fee Schedule — testo IT invariato, ripristinata la resa v8.
u013: economic result → financial result — 'risultato economico' dell'attività di compravendita; calco.
u023: and namely → namely — errore di grammatica.
u046: and which can also be implemented → and also capable of being implemented — 'and which' senza relativa precedente.
u049: the technical and administrative characteristics → the characteristics, technical and administrative, — ripristinato l'ordine della resa v8 (l'IT toglie solo 'sia... che').
